title: Harassment
grade_or_penalty: Petty disorderly persons offense. Fourth degree if the actor was then serving a prison term or on parole/probation for an indictable conviction, or knowingly aimed the conduct at a current or former judge over the judge's public duties.
key_points: (a) Communications that are anonymous, at extremely inconvenient hours, in offensively coarse language, or otherwise likely to annoy or alarm. Venue can be where sent or where received.
(b) Striking, kicking, shoving or other offensive touching, or threatening to.
(c) Any other course of alarming conduct or repeated acts meant to alarm or seriously annoy.
officer_notes: Capture screenshots, call logs and timestamps for subsection (a) cases.
Check parole/probation status; it can make the offense a crime.
elements: The suspect acted with purpose to harass another
(a): made or caused communications anonymously, at extremely inconvenient hours, in offensively coarse language, or in another manner likely to cause annoyance or alarm
OR (b): subjected the victim to striking, kicking, shoving or other offensive touching, or threatened to do so
OR (c): engaged in a course of alarming conduct or repeatedly committed acts with purpose to alarm or seriously annoy

subsections.label: a
subsections.text: With purpose to harass, makes communications anonymously, at extremely inconvenient hours, in offensively coarse language, or in a manner likely to cause annoyance or alarm

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: With purpose to harass, subjects another to striking, kicking, shoving or other offensive touching, or threatens to

subsections.label: c
subsections.text: With purpose to alarm or seriously annoy, engages in a course of alarming conduct or repeated acts

subsections.label: e
subsections.text: Upgrade if committed while serving a prison term or on parole or probation for an indictable offense, or aimed at a judge because of judicial duties
